criteria.requirement: Add funcy.scoped.wrap_with_factory(factory) without changing wrap_with(ctx). Create fresh no-arg managers per execution; normal sync calls use sync context, generators enter on first consumption and retain resource through yield/throw/close, coroutine and async-generator wrappers accept sync or async managers. Async generator aclose must close the wrapped generator before leaving the manager. Preserve original enter/exit failures, manager suppression policy, function metadata, original exception and cancellation cleanup. Prove repeated calls never reuse one-shot managers and resources remain open only during actual execution.
